comment:
Expected: Normal seeded mock data, aggregates, and attention content render without a connected dependency.
Actual: ✔ Dashboard normal: KPI ₹48,250 + recent rows | ✔ Finance normal: aggregates + attention
description: Open the verified local app with ?mock=1 and record the normal Dashboard and Finance mock state before arming a read failure.
expectedResult: Normal seeded mock data, aggregates, and attention content render without a connected dependency.

comment:
Expected: The screen renders the translated read-failure message and the intended retry/recovery affordance instead of raw exception text, a stack trace, or a blank unhandled state.
Actual: ✔ translated read-failure message shown | ✔ retry affordance visible | ✔ no raw exception/stack | ✔ Finance also shows failure (simulate persists across in-app nav)
description: Open Dashboard or Finance with ?mock=1&simulateError=1 and wait for the read operation to complete.
expectedResult: The screen renders the translated read-failure message and the intended retry/recovery affordance instead of raw exception text, a stack trace, or a blank unhandled state.

comment:
Expected: No token, credential, raw request body, stack trace, or connected-service internals are exposed; stale rows and misleading aggregates are not presented as current data.
Actual: ✔ no stale rows or aggregates shown on the failed screen | ✔ no token/credential terms exposed | console errors: none
description: Inspect the failed screen, browser console-visible UI surface, and any displayed request/error details.
expectedResult: No token, credential, raw request body, stack trace, or connected-service internals are exposed; stale rows and misleading aggregates are not presented as current data.

comment:
Expected: Normal mock reads succeed, the expected seeded data/aggregates return, and no duplicate or partial read-side effect is created.
Actual: ✔ normal reads succeed after removing simulateError; seeded KPI + rows return
description: Remove simulateError=1, retain ?mock=1, and use the visible retry/reload affordance or revisit the same screen.
expectedResult: Normal mock reads succeed, the expected seeded data/aggregates return, and no duplicate or partial read-side effect is created.

comment:
Expected: Both screens remain healthy after recovery, the error state is cleared, and no stale failure switch or stale error content reappears.
Actual: ✔ Finance healthy | ✔ Dashboard healthy | ✔ after refresh: healthy, no stale error | ✔ no stale failure switch in URL: http://localhost:5173/?mock=1
description: Navigate between Dashboard and Finance and refresh once on the normal mock URL.
expectedResult: Both screens remain healthy after recovery, the error state is cleared, and no stale failure switch or stale error content reappears.
